[{"name":"kg_calculate_confidence_score","args":"p_current_km integer, p_maintenance_records jsonb, p_ctx_phase text, p_ctx_temp text, p_ctx_speed text, p_observable_count integer, p_vehicle_id uuid, p_engine_family_code text, p_has_dtc boolean","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kg_calculate_confidence_score(p_current_km integer, p_maintenance_records jsonb, p_ctx_phase text, p_ctx_temp text, p_ctx_speed text, p_observable_count integer, p_vehicle_id uuid, p_engine_family_code text, p_has_dtc boolean)\n RETURNS TABLE(confidence_score integer, confidence_level text, confidence_factors jsonb, missing_factors text[], improvement_tips text[], confidence_explanation text)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_config RECORD; v_has_km BOOLEAN; v_has_history BOOLEAN; v_has_context BOOLEAN;\n  v_has_multiple_obs BOOLEAN; v_has_known_vehicle BOOLEAN;\n  v_score INT; v_level TEXT; v_missing TEXT[] := '{}'; v_tips TEXT[] := '{}'; v_explanation TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_config FROM kg_confidence_config WHERE is_active = TRUE LIMIT 1;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    v_config := ROW(40, 15, 20, 10, 5, 10, 15, 80, 65, 50, 35, TRUE);\n  END IF;\n\n  v_has_km := p_current_km IS NOT NULL;\n  v_has_history := p_maintenance_records IS NOT NULL AND JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(COALESCE(p_maintenance_records, '[]'::JSONB)) > 0;\n  v_has_context := ((p_ctx_phase IS NOT NULL)::INT + (p_ctx_temp IS NOT NULL)::INT + (p_ctx_speed IS NOT NULL)::INT) >= 2;\n  v_has_multiple_obs := p_observable_count > 1;\n  v_has_known_vehicle := p_vehicle_id IS NOT NULL OR p_engine_family_code IS NOT NULL;\n\n  v_score := COALESCE(v_config.weight_base, 40)\n    + (CASE WHEN v_has_km THEN COALESCE(v_config.weight_km, 15) ELSE 0 END)\n    + (CASE WHEN v_has_history THEN COALESCE(v_config.weight_history, 20) ELSE 0 END)\n    + (CASE WHEN v_has_context THEN COALESCE(v_config.weight_context, 10) ELSE 0 END)\n    + (CASE WHEN v_has_multiple_obs THEN COALESCE(v_config.weight_multiple_observables, 5) ELSE 0 END)\n    + (CASE WHEN v_has_known_vehicle THEN COALESCE(v_config.weight_known_vehicle, 10) ELSE 0 END)\n    + (CASE WHEN p_has_dtc THEN COALESCE(v_config.weight_dtc, 15) ELSE 0 END);\n\n  IF v_score >= COALESCE(v_config.threshold_high, 80) THEN v_level := 'high'; v_explanation := 'Diagnostic fiable - données complètes';\n  ELSIF v_score >= COALESCE(v_config.threshold_good, 65) THEN v_level := 'good';\n  ELSIF v_score >= COALESCE(v_config.threshold_medium, 50) THEN v_level := 'medium';\n  ELSIF v_score >= COALESCE(v_config.threshold_low, 35) THEN v_level := 'low';\n  ELSE v_level := 'very_low'; END IF;\n\n  IF NOT v_has_km THEN v_missing := array_append(v_missing, 'km'); v_tips := array_append(v_tips, 'Ajoutez le kilométrage pour +15% de confidence'); END IF;\n  IF NOT v_has_history THEN v_missing := array_append(v_missing, 'historique'); v_tips := array_append(v_tips, 'Ajoutez l''historique d''entretien pour +20% de confidence'); END IF;\n  IF NOT v_has_context THEN v_missing := array_append(v_missing, 'contexte'); v_tips := array_append(v_tips, 'Précisez le contexte (phase, température, vitesse) pour +10%'); END IF;\n  IF NOT v_has_known_vehicle THEN v_missing := array_append(v_missing, 'véhicule'); v_tips := array_append(v_tips, 'Identifiez le véhicule pour +10%'); END IF;\n  IF NOT p_has_dtc THEN v_missing := array_append(v_missing, 'code_obd'); v_tips := array_append(v_tips, 'Un code OBD augmente la confidence de +15%'); END IF;\n\n  IF v_level != 'high' THEN\n    IF v_level = 'good' THEN v_explanation := 'Diagnostic probable - ' || ARRAY_TO_STRING(v_missing, ', ') || ' manquant(s)';\n    ELSIF v_level = 'medium' THEN v_explanation := 'Diagnostic indicatif - informations limitées';\n    ELSIF v_level = 'low' THEN v_explanation := 'Diagnostic à confirmer - plusieurs données manquantes';\n    ELSE v_explanation := 'Informations insuffisantes pour un diagnostic fiable'; END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_score, v_level,\n    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('has_km', v_has_km, 'has_history', v_has_history, 'has_context', v_has_context, 'has_multiple_observables', v_has_multiple_obs, 'has_known_vehicle', v_has_known_vehicle, 'has_dtc', p_has_dtc),\n    v_missing, v_tips, v_explanation;\nEND;\n$function$\n"},{"name":"kg_check_safety_gate","args":"p_observable_ids uuid[]","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kg_check_safety_gate(p_observable_ids uuid[])\n RETURNS TABLE(has_safety_concern boolean, highest_gate text, safety_message text, recommended_action text, can_continue_driving boolean, block_sales boolean, show_emergency_contact boolean, emergency_contact text, triggered_observables jsonb)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_gate_priority JSONB := '{\"none\": 0, \"warning\": 1, \"stop_soon\": 2, \"stop_immediate\": 3}';\nBEGIN\n  RETURN QUERY\n  WITH\n  node_gates AS (\n    SELECT\n      n.node_id,\n      n.node_label,\n      n.safety_gate,\n      (v_gate_priority->>n.safety_gate)::INT AS gate_level\n    FROM kg_nodes n\n    WHERE n.node_id = ANY(p_observable_ids)\n      AND n.safety_gate IS NOT NULL\n      AND n.safety_gate != 'none'\n  ),\n  trigger_matches AS (\n    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.trigger_id)\n      t.trigger_id,\n      t.safety_gate,\n      t.safety_message_fr,\n      t.recommended_action_fr,\n      t.block_sales AS t_block_sales,\n      t.show_emergency_contact AS t_show_emergency,\n      t.emergency_contact AS t_emergency_contact,\n      t.priority,\n      n.node_id,\n      n.node_label,\n      (v_gate_priority->>t.safety_gate)::INT AS gate_level\n    FROM kg_safety_triggers t\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (\n      SELECT kn.node_id, kn.node_label, kn.dtc_code, kn.intensity\n      FROM kg_nodes kn\n      WHERE kn.node_id = ANY(p_observable_ids)\n        AND (\n          kn.node_label ILIKE t.observable_label_pattern\n          OR (t.dtc_code_pattern IS NOT NULL AND kn.dtc_code ILIKE t.dtc_code_pattern)\n        )\n        AND (t.intensity_min IS NULL OR COALESCE(kn.intensity, 3) >= t.intensity_min)\n    ) n\n    WHERE t.is_active = TRUE\n    ORDER BY t.trigger_id, t.priority DESC\n  ),\n  all_concerns AS (\n    SELECT\n      node_id,\n      node_label,\n      safety_gate,\n      gate_level,\n      NULL::TEXT AS safety_message_fr,\n      NULL::TEXT AS recommended_action_fr,\n      FALSE AS c_block_sales,\n      FALSE AS c_show_emergency,\n      NULL::TEXT AS c_emergency_contact\n    FROM node_gates\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT\n      node_id,\n      node_label,\n      safety_gate,\n      gate_level,\n      safety_message_fr,\n      recommended_action_fr,\n      t_block_sales,\n      t_show_emergency,\n      t_emergency_contact\n    FROM trigger_matches\n  ),\n  highest AS (\n    SELECT * FROM all_concerns ORDER BY gate_level DESC LIMIT 1\n  ),\n  all_triggered AS (\n    SELECT jsonb_agg(\n      jsonb_build_object('node_id', node_id, 'label', node_label, 'gate', safety_gate)\n    ) AS triggered\n    FROM all_concerns\n  )\n  SELECT\n    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM all_concerns),\n    COALESCE(h.safety_gate, 'none'),\n    h.safety_message_fr,\n    h.recommended_action_fr,\n    COALESCE(h.safety_gate, 'none') NOT IN ('stop_immediate', 'stop_soon'),\n    COALESCE(h.c_block_sales, FALSE),\n    COALESCE(h.c_show_emergency, FALSE),\n    h.c_emergency_contact,\n    at.triggered\n  FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy\n  LEFT JOIN highest h ON TRUE\n  LEFT JOIN all_triggered at ON TRUE;\nEND;\n$function$\n"},{"name":"kg_diagnose_with_explainable_score","args":"p_observable_ids uuid[], p_vehicle_id uuid, p_engine_family_code text, p_current_km integer, p_last_maintenance_records jsonb, p_ctx_phase text, p_ctx_temp text, p_ctx_speed text, p_limit integer","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kg_diagnose_with_explainable_score(p_observable_ids uuid[], p_vehicle_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_engine_family_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_current_km integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_last_maintenance_records jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, p_ctx_phase text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_ctx_temp text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_ctx_speed text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)\n RETURNS TABLE(fault_id uuid, fault_label text, fault_family text, probability_score integer, probability_level text, raw_score double precision, confidence_score integer, confidence_level text, confidence_factors jsonb, missing_factors text[], improvement_tips text[], confidence_explanation text, matched_observables integer, total_observables integer, matched_observable_labels text[], is_vehicle_specific boolean, engine_family_boost double precision, recommended_actions jsonb, diagnostic_timestamp timestamp with time zone)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_has_dtc BOOLEAN := FALSE;\n  v_observable_count INT;\n  v_config RECORD;\n  v_conf_score INT;\n  v_conf_level TEXT;\n  v_conf_factors JSONB;\n  v_missing TEXT[];\n  v_tips TEXT[];\n  v_conf_explanation TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_config FROM kg_confidence_config WHERE is_active = TRUE LIMIT 1;\n  v_observable_count := COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(p_observable_ids, 1), 0);\n\n  -- Calculate confidence score once\n  SELECT cs.confidence_score, cs.confidence_level, cs.confidence_factors, cs.missing_factors, cs.improvement_tips, cs.confidence_explanation\n  INTO v_conf_score, v_conf_level, v_conf_factors, v_missing, v_tips, v_conf_explanation\n  FROM kg_calculate_confidence_score(\n    p_current_km, p_last_maintenance_records, p_ctx_phase, p_ctx_temp, p_ctx_speed,\n    v_observable_count, p_vehicle_id, p_engine_family_code, v_has_dtc\n  ) cs;\n\n  RETURN QUERY\n  WITH diagnosed_faults AS (\n    SELECT\n      f.node_id AS fault_id,\n      f.node_label AS fault_label,\n      f.node_category AS fault_family,\n      SUM(e.weight * e.confidence) AS total_raw_score,\n      COUNT(DISTINCT e.source_node_id) AS matched_count,\n      ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT o.node_label) AS matched_labels,\n      FALSE AS is_specific,\n      1.0::FLOAT AS max_boost\n    FROM kg_nodes f\n    JOIN kg_edges e ON e.target_node_id = f.node_id\n      AND e.edge_type = 'CAUSES'\n      AND e.is_active = TRUE\n    JOIN kg_nodes o ON o.node_id = e.source_node_id\n    WHERE f.node_type = 'Fault'\n      AND f.is_active = TRUE\n      AND e.source_node_id = ANY(p_observable_ids)\n    GROUP BY f.node_id, f.node_label, f.node_category\n    ORDER BY total_raw_score DESC\n    LIMIT p_limit\n  ),\n  fault_actions AS (\n    SELECT\n      df.fault_id,\n      JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n        'action_id', a.node_id,\n        'action_label', a.node_label\n      )) AS actions\n    FROM diagnosed_faults df\n    JOIN kg_edges ea ON ea.source_node_id = df.fault_id AND ea.edge_type = 'DIAGNOSED_BY'\n    JOIN kg_nodes a ON a.node_id = ea.target_node_id AND a.node_type = 'Action'\n    GROUP BY df.fault_id\n  )\n  SELECT\n    df.fault_id,\n    df.fault_label,\n    df.fault_family,\n    LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, (df.total_raw_score / NULLIF(df.matched_count, 0) * 10)::INT))::INT AS probability_score,\n    CASE\n      WHEN df.total_raw_score >= v_config.prob_very_high_threshold * df.matched_count THEN 'very_high'\n      WHEN df.total_raw_score >= v_config.prob_high_threshold * df.matched_count THEN 'high'\n      WHEN df.total_raw_score >= v_config.prob_medium_threshold * df.matched_count THEN 'medium'\n      WHEN df.total_raw_score >= v_config.prob_low_threshold * df.matched_count THEN 'low'\n      ELSE 'very_low'\n    END AS probability_level,\n    df.total_raw_score AS raw_score,\n    v_conf_score AS confidence_score,\n    v_conf_level AS confidence_level,\n    v_conf_factors AS confidence_factors,\n    v_missing AS missing_factors,\n    v_tips AS improvement_tips,\n    v_conf_explanation AS confidence_explanation,\n    df.matched_count::INT AS matched_observables,\n    v_observable_count AS total_observables,\n    df.matched_labels AS matched_observable_labels,\n    df.is_specific AS is_vehicle_specific,\n    df.max_boost AS engine_family_boost,\n    COALESCE(fa.actions, '[]'::JSONB) AS recommended_actions,\n    NOW() AS diagnostic_timestamp\n  FROM diagnosed_faults df\n  LEFT JOIN fault_actions fa ON fa.fault_id = df.fault_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n"}]
